summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an ordinary share buyback transaction. On 19 May 2026, the company purchased 10,000,000 of its own ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume weighted average price of 96.4346 pence per share as part of an existing buyback programme announced 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled. This is a routine open-market repurchase pursuant to an earlier announced programme, not a tender offer or capital return event. No special situation exists; it is standard share buyback execution.
